These are runtime exceptions that, if uncaught, would propagate up from the handle method, potentially disrupting the event loop or framework error handling. Therefore, it is necessary to catch these exceptions within this snippet to handle them gracefully (e.g., by failing the context). No other synchronous runtime exceptions are expected.
